title: Grievance controller split into base + browse + main
summary: Refactored the monolithic GrievanceController (~1750 lines) into a three-class inheritance chain so write actions stay in GrievanceController while shared helpers and read/browse routes live in parent classes.
changes: Added App/Controllers/GrievanceBaseController.php — constants, constructor, validation, attachment upload, escalation helpers, attachmentUrl()
Added App/Controllers/GrievanceBrowseController.php — dashboard, calendar, list, respondents, export/PDF, show, serve attachment routes
GrievanceController now extends GrievanceBrowseController and contains only create/store/edit/update/delete/restore/status actions
No route or API contract changes; GrievanceController::attachmentUrl() remains callable via inheritance
